fnol_text: My name is Priya O'Connell and I live at 141 Kestrel Avenue, Ashland, OR 97539. You can reach me on (555) 480-2550 or priya.oconnell@example.com. On 5 June 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2023-00146. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. Am I insured for this or not?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs O'Connell on (555) 480-2550 to acknowledge the claim. Priya confirmed the loss date as 5 June 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Yusuf Gallagher gave a statement by phone.
Priya sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
